exposure: Angle of progression (AOP) measured by transperineal ultrasonography (TPU)
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
finding: Serial TPU measurements of AOP during labor can predict the mode of delivery, with an AOP greater than 132.5 degrees indicating a high probability of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: An angle of progression (AOP) greater than 132.5 degrees measured by transperineal ultrasonography (TPU) during labor was associated with a high probability of vaginal delivery.
